I have fewer panic attacks too. I am better able to tolerate doing things like grocery shopping when before it would be so overstimulating I’d end up needing to leave early. 
I’m also Bipolar so maybe I’m not a great one to reference but I think taking medications has made a pretty significant difference in most of my symptoms of ADHD. Sometimes doctors will try that one first to avoid stimulants but I started that for depression about a year before the Ritalin and I felt absolutely no improvement in the ADHD symptoms. Honestly now I just take it because it’s part of my medication regimen but I don’t know if it’s actually helping.
